item.title: 'I haven't slept for days': Iranians describe mounting desperation after a month of war
item.summary: Ordinary people from various parts of Iran describe expanding strikes, economic pain and fear of repression.

item.title: Iran war could make beer and bottled water pricier for Indians
item.summary: Makers of plastic and glass bottles are struggling to access raw materials as the war squeezes supplies.

item.title: 'Be serious... don't speak every day': Macron criticises Trump approach to Iran war
item.summary: The comments were an apparent jab at the US leader's sometimes contradictory stance on the US-Israeli war against Iran.

item.title: Iran's two largest steel plants shut down due to air strikes, companies say
item.summary: The strikes, which Iran says were first launched by Israel in co-ordination with the US last week, could cause major damage to the Iranian economy.

item.title: Iranian Nobel laureate suffered suspected heart attack in prison, family says
item.summary: Narges Mohammadi's brother says he fears her life is in imminent danger and she needs to be transferred to a hospital.

item.title: Over 1,800 killed since junta seized power in Burkina Faso, rights group says
item.summary: Human Rights Watch says Capt Traoré, other military leaders and jihadists "may be liable" for the killings.

item.title: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake hits off Indonesia, killing one
item.summary: The quake struck between the islands of Manado and Ternate. Tsunami warnings have now been lifted.

item.title: Judge dismisses most of Blake Lively's claims in Justin Baldoni harassment suit
item.summary: The judge left in place three allegations against Baldoni, meaning the civil trial will go ahead next month.

item.title: Baby shot dead in pram in New York City, police say
item.summary: The seven-month-old child is the unintended victim of a suspected gang-related shooting, officials say.

item.title: US lifts sanctions on Venezuelan interim leader Delcy Rodríguez
item.summary: It is the latest sign of warming relations between the US and Venezuela after Nicolás Maduro was seized in a commando raid.
